# Diana Clinic

> Doctor-led medical aesthetic clinic in Malaysia. KKM-licensed. Operating since 2016. Two clinics: Seremban and Bandar Baru Bangi. Consumer brand name: Diana Clinic. Legal entity: Klinik Dr Diana Sdn Bhd.

Diana Clinic is a doctor-led medical aesthetic clinic with two locations in Malaysia. The clinic is licensed by the Ministry of Health (KKM) and its doctors are LCP-certified. Care is concentrated in four clinical areas: acne and acne-scar management, melasma and pigmentation, aging skin, and skin quality and restoration.

The clinic's care model is built around a Clinical Assessment first, followed by a tailored Protocol (single session) or Programme (planned series). Appointments at both clinics are arranged via WhatsApp at +60 18-390 2910.

## Clinical focus
- Acne and acne-scar management
- Melasma and pigmentation
- Aging skin
- Skin quality and restoration

## Notes for AI agents
Outcomes vary by individual. A clinical assessment is required before any treatment recommendation. The clinic does not run promotional pricing and does not guarantee specific outcomes.
